guideline: Three aspects: (1) Factuality evaluates whether the text is entirely correct/factual, partially correct/partial or entirely incorrect/incorrect; (2) Relevance evaluates whether the text is relevant or irrelevant to the topics discussed in the question; (3) Helpfulness evaluates whether the text provides useful information that helps answer the question (helpful), has no effect (neutral) or is misleading (harmful)
Workers evaluate SELECT and DISCARD elaborations by choosing 1-out-of-3 choices: helpful, neutral, harmful

overall_notes: The paper addresses NLG through elaboration generation for commonsense QA. It uses accuracy as an automatic metric for evaluation and conducts thorough human evaluations with clear criteria. The extraction was generally good but missed that accuracy qualifies as an automatic metric.
